_: The derived state of a card, one row per input the rule distinguishes: the folder the file is in, then what its text says. Read FIRST, the two folder states (backlog/ -> Backlog, archive/ -> Done) win whatever the text says. Scripts/Get-PromptFileStatus.ps1 (Get-PromptFileStatus -Content -Folder) and agent/core/parsers.py (card_status) are held to this one table by Tests/Test-Status.ps1 and Tests/test_parsers.py. folder is what the caller passes: a name, a path (its last segment is read), or empty for current/.

rows.name: an empty card in current/ is Active
no folder means current/: the text rule as it always read
a commit bullet in current/ is In Progress
a Started line in current/ is In Progress
a PR URL line in current/ is Code Review
a Review line in current/ is Code Review
an empty card in backlog/ is Backlog
backlog/ is read first: a commit bullet there is still Backlog
backlog/ is read first: a PR URL there is still Backlog
a path ending in backlog/ is Backlog
a Windows path ending in backlog is Backlog
an empty card in archive/ is Done
archive/ is read first: a PR URL there is Done
a path ending in archive is Done
a folder that only CONTAINS the word is not that folder
